description: Open one or more projects: the short description, the quality index broken down by axis with an explanation of what each axis measures, the site type, the niches the project belongs to and its nearest neighbors by meaning. Use it to decide whether a project is worth revealing. A revealed project also lists its other domains (regional versions, mirrors). It returns no domain for projects your organization has not revealed and no traffic figures beyond the scale and growth bands of the card. The projects you open spend no coverage; every neighbor and niche shown to your organization for the first time this period costs the first-seen price on top of the base price and spends one unit of coverage, so leave out the parts you do not need. For its traffic use get_audience, get_channels and get_keywords.

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

parts.description: Which sections to include, all when omitted; the card with its description is always returned, and only the neighbors and cohorts parts spend coverage

project_ids.description: Projects to open; refused above batch.get_project_card in capabilities; required unless quote_token is given

items.description: Opaque project id as returned by this server to your organization

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

name: get_project_card
title: Open project cards
